motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Susan Allen as a Senior Citizen Advisor through December 31, 2025
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to approve the appointment of Susan Allen as a Senior Citizen Advisor through December 31, 2025. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Appoint Susan Allen as senior citizen advisor
motions.summary: The council appointed Susan Allen as a Senior Citizen Advisor, a term running through December 31, 2025.
motions.impact: Nothing changes day to day. If you're an older resident, Susan Allen is the person advising the city on senior issues through the end of 2025.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve routine consent items in one vote
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of routine items passed together in a single vote; the individual items aren't named in the motion.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents.

motions.item_title: Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Alpine School District Elementary 133
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Alpine School District Elementary 133. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Rezone the land for the new elementary school
motions.summary: The council changed the zoning on the land for Alpine School District's Elementary 133 so the elementary school can be built there.
motions.impact: This is the zoning half of the school approval. For neighbors, the parcel is now zoned for a school; for everyone else, nothing changes.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved adopt Alpine School District Elementary 133 Preliminary Plat and Site Plan. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve site plan for a new elementary school
motions.summary: The council approved the preliminary plat and site plan for Alpine School District's Elementary 133, signing off on how the school site will be laid out.
motions.impact: If you live near the site, this clears the way for a new elementary school to be built. The motion doesn't give a location or an opening date.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah approving the Culinary Water Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah approving the Culinary Water Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP). Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Adopt a long-range drinking water plan
motions.summary: The council adopted the city's drinking water master plan and the companion plan that sets the basis for fees new development pays toward water facilities.
motions.impact: Your water bill doesn't change because of this vote. It lays out the city's plan for future water lines and wells and the basis for charges on new construction.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the First Amendment to Master Development Agreement for Ault Farms (Parkway Fields)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the First Amendment to Master Development Agreement for Ault Farms (Parkway Fields), including a nine-month sunset clause in the Amendment. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Amend the Ault Farms (Parkway Fields) development deal
motions.summary: The city approved the first change to its development agreement for Ault Farms (Parkway Fields), adding a nine-month sunset clause that puts an expiration on the new terms.
motions.impact: Unless you live near Parkway Fields, nothing changes for you. The motion doesn't spell out what the amendment alters — only that the new terms carry a nine-month expiration.
